fdroid:dev.lexip.hecate.name: Adaptive Theme
fdroid:dev.lexip.hecate.summary: Auto-switch dark theme & wallpapers using the ambient light sensor
fdroid:dev.lexip.hecate.description:
Adaptive Theme switches Android's system-wide theme between light and dark mode according to the ambient light sensor instead of relying on sunset or a fixed schedule. Use light mode in bright surroundings and dark mode in low light, with the threshold under your control.
It can also switch your wallpaper to match the active theme.
 Features 
 Uses the device's physical ambient light sensor
 Custom lux threshold and presets for indoor, outdoor, and daylight conditions
 Wallpaper Theme Sync for separate light and dark home and lock screen wallpapers
 Optional blur effect for the lock screen wallpaper
 Optional night lock to keep dark mode active during a chosen time period
 Quick Settings tile for convenient control
 Material You interface and more than 50 languages
 Efficient by design 
The sensor is sampled briefly after the screen turns on rather than monitored continuously. Before changing the theme, Adaptive Theme checks that the sensor is not covered by a hand or pocket. Theme changes therefore happen at screen-on and do not interrupt you while you are actively using another app.
 One-time setup 
Android does not normally allow regular apps to change protected system settings such as the system theme. Adaptive Theme therefore needs a one-time grant of the WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS permission. This permission does not grant root access or allow the app to read personal data. Adaptive Theme uses it only to switch the light and dark system theme, and it is revoked when the app is uninstalled.
The guided setup offers several options:
 WebADB through a simple website on a computer or secondary Android device, without installing ADB
 Shizuku and compatible Shizuku forks, required only once while granting the permission
 Root on supported devices
 A manual ADB command: adb shell pm grant dev.lexip.hecate android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
 More 
Adaptive Theme requires Android 14 or newer. Tablets are currently not supported.
The FOSS build is licensed under GPL-3.0 and contains no ads, analytics, crash reporting, trackers, or proprietary libraries.
For troubleshooting and additional details, see the README and FAQ .

flathub:com.voxdsp.VoxelPaint.description:
Mouse locks when you click on the game window, press ESCAPE or TAB to unlock the mouse.
 W,A,S,D = Move around based on relative orientation to X and Y.
 SPACE + L-SHIFT = Move up and down relative Z.
 Left Click / R-SHIFT = Place node.
 Right Click / R-CTRL = Delete node.
 Q / Middle Click = Clone texture of pointed node.
 R = Places node at your current position.
 E / F / Mouse4 = Toggle player fast speed on and off.
 1-7 = Change move speed for selected fast state.
 X + C / Slash + Quote = Change texture of pointed node.
 T = Resets player state to start.
 G = Gravity on/off.
 P = Toggle pitch lock.
 F3 = Save. (auto saves on exit or idle for more than 3 minutes)
 F8 = Load. (will erase what you have done since the last save)
 F10 = Export the VoxelPaint data to a zip file in $HOME/EXPORTS.
 To multiselect click and drag with Middle Mouse or Q. Fill the nodes with B or delete them with N. Middle Scroll or X+C to change texture. V to paste selected nodes to pointed position.
 Arrow Keys can be used to move the view around.
 Your state is automatically saved on exit.
 You can customize the 17 block tileset, in your dataPath you will find a tiles.ppm image file, edit this file and save it as a PPM with a P6 272 16 255 header. Krita or KolourPaint can edit PPM files.
 Sensitivity as the 1st command line parameter default is 0.003 `./voxelpaintpro 0.003`.

firefox-addons:3007294.name: Shinkansen - Blazing fast web & YouTube translator
firefox-addons:3007294.summary: Fast, private, high-quality AI translation: text replaced in place with the layout intact; YouTube subtitles, PDF, EPUB, Word and subtitle files too. Connects straight to the AI model — your data never passes through a third party
firefox-addons:3007294.description:
Shinkansen is a fast, private, high-quality translation extension that uses AI models to translate foreign-language web pages, YouTube subtitles and documents into your language. Text is replaced in place so the page layout stays intact, and requests go straight to the AI model — your data never passes through a third party
Recent major updates:
• New: X video subtitle translation — videos with auto captions are translated into your language when played with sound; muted autoplay videos in the timeline are skipped and cost nothing
 • Custom models work with more endpoints — choose Responses as the API format and add custom request headers
 • Document translation — much better PDF layout for tables, tables of contents and pages with images; no more leftover internal markers in the output
 • Web pages — multiple paragraphs inside tables and lists are no longer sent twice; fixes for skipped image captions and oversized inline icons
 • Safer settings import — when a settings file would change the custom model API endpoint, the new URL is shown for you to confirm first
 • iOS and iPadOS version is on the App Store — a Safari extension with three- or four-finger touch translate and the floating button
Features:
Instant translation
The page starts changing within 1 second of pressing translate — no waiting for the whole batch of API calls to come back first (Gemini only)
Preserves page layout
In-place text replacement keeps fonts, sizes, colors and links intact — it looks like a page originally written in your language
Bilingual side-by-side
Original and translation shown together for language learning or proofreading; switch between overlay and bilingual modes anytime
Multi-language translation + UI
Translate into any of 8 target languages, and the extension interface switches to match
Document translation
Upload a whole PDF, EPUB book, Word document, TXT, Markdown, HTML or subtitle file — everything is processed inside the browser, nothing is uploaded to a server. PDF output keeps the original layout; EPUB gets a book-wide glossary and a post-translation consistency scan; Word translations are written back into the original file; edit any paragraph before exporting, with monolingual or bilingual output for most formats
YouTube subtitle translation
Watch YouTube videos with the captions auto-translated into your language, with optional bilingual display; auto-generated captions are re-segmented by meaning into readable full sentences
Respects do-not-translate markup
Content that site authors mark as not-to-translate is kept as-is and never sent to the API, and icon-font glyphs are never turned into text
Auto-translate across pages
Once a page is translated, clicking links or pressing Back also auto-translates the next page — no need to trigger translation on every page
Floating button
A draggable button at the page edge: tap to translate, long-press to switch engines or open the menu; position, size and opacity are adjustable
Custom glossary
Pin specific terms to your preferred translations so proper nouns are always rendered consistently — global and per-site layers, CSV import, room for hundreds of entries
Blocked-word list
An editable list of words you don't want in the translation (26 defaults). Block a word on its own, or pair it with a required replacement — the LLM is explicitly instructed to comply
Translate opening only
Preview the first few paragraphs before deciding whether to translate the whole article — saves a lot of tokens
Translation cache
Already-translated paragraphs are cached automatically — re-opening the same page costs nothing
Transparent pricing
Cost is shown live during translation. The settings page tracks token usage and cost for every past run, with charts and CSV export
Three translation engines
Gemini, Google Translate and custom models coexist as three engines — switch freely depending on context. A custom model can point at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, whether a cloud service or a model you run yourself
Free Chinese variant conversion
Built-in dictionaries convert between Simplified and Traditional Chinese locally — no API key, no API calls, works offline — with phrase-level Taiwan-convention mapping. Auto-convert on page load is on by default
Send to Instapaper
Save the whole translated article to Instapaper in one click, with a summary in your target language, for later re-reading
Custom shortcuts
Three customizable shortcuts (Alt+A, Alt+S, Alt+D) for switching engines and models on the fly

firefox-addons:2972295.summary: Local Manga Translator allows you to read raw Manga (Japanese), Manhwa (Korean), and Manhua (Chinese) by capturing text from your browser and translating it using a powerful AI server running locally on your computer.
firefox-addons:2972295.description:
🦊 Firefox Add-on Description & Instructions
⚠️ IMPORTANT: REQUIRES COMPANION SCRIPT 
This add-on is a "connector" tool. To perform the translation, you must run the free companion Python script ( manga_server.py ) on your computer.
 ✨ Key Features 
 Universal Hardware Support: Works on NVIDIA (CUDA), AMD/Intel (Vulkan), or CPU.
 Specialized Japanese OCR: Uses Manga-OCR to read vertical, handwritten, and messy manga text perfectly.
 Advanced Bubble Detection: Now uses Comic-Text-Detector (specialized for Manga/Manhwa) to accurately split connected bubbles and ignore background noise.
 Smart Korean Mode: Uses PaddleOCR for high-accuracy recognition of Korean webtoons.
 Natural AI Translation: Connects to local LLMs (like Qwen, Llama 3) for human-quality translation.
 100% Private & Free: No API keys, no monthly fees. Everything runs offline.
 🛠️ Step-by-Step Installation Guide 
 Step 1: Install Visual Studio Build Tools (Windows Only) 
 Download Visual Studio Build Tools 2022 from the Microsoft website.
 Run the installer.
 CRITICAL: Select the workload named "Desktop development with C++" .
 Ensure the checklist on the right includes "Windows 10/11 SDK" and "MSVC... C++ x64/x86 build tools".
 Click Install and wait for it to finish.
 Step 2: Install Python 
 Download Python 3.10.11 from python.org .
 CRITICAL: During installation, check the box "Add Python to PATH" .
 Step 3: Download & Setup the Server Files 
 1. Get the Main Script 
 Download manga_server.py from thehttps:// github.com/Camekan/Manga_server.py/blob/main/manga_server.py and place it in a new folder (e.g., C:\MangaTranslator ).
 2. Get the Comic Detector (Critical Step) 
 Download this ZIP file: https://github.com/dmMaze/comic-text-detector/archive/refs/heads/master.zip 
 Extract the ZIP. You will see a folder named comic-text-detector-master .
 RENAME that folder to: comic_text_detector 
 ⚠️ Important: Use underscores _ , not dashes - . 
 MOVE this folder next to manga_server.py .
 3. Get the Detector Model (Optional - Auto-downloads on first run) 
 The script will try to download this automatically. If it fails, do this: 
 Download the model file: https://github.com/zyddnys/manga-image-translator/releases/download/beta-0.2.1/comictextdetector.pt 
 Create a new folder named models inside your comic_text_detector folder if it isn`t there..
 Place the .pt file there.
 Correct Path: C:\MangaTranslator\comic_text_detector\models\ comictextdetector.pt 
 Your folder must look exactly like this: 
MangaTranslator/
├── manga_server.py 
└── comic_text_detector/ <-- The folder you renamed

firefox-addons:3031820.name: YDownloadNow – Video Downloader & MP3
firefox-addons:3031820.summary: Download YouTube music and videos right on your Android phone, with Firefox — no extra app needed. Also TikTok, X, Twitch, Suno and any page playing a video. Saves MP4 or MP3 and shows each quality's size first. Never touches DRM.
firefox-addons:3031820.description:
Download music and videos from YouTube, TikTok, X and more on your Android phone or your computer — just Firefox, no extra app.
YDownloadNow finds the video a page is actually playing and saves it as a normal file — on Firefox for desktop and on Firefox for Android.
Most videos on the web are not a single file: they are streams cut into hundreds of small segments. Your browser can play them, but it has no button to save them. YDownloadNow reads the playlist, downloads every segment and rebuilds the video into an MP4 — without re-encoding, so there is no quality loss and no long wait.
WHAT IT DOES
 Detects streaming video and ordinary media files on the page you are on, while you watch.
 YouTube, TikTok, X (Twitter), Twitch and many other video and social sites: open the video and it shows up in the list.
 Suno songs: open the song's page and save it as an MP4 file, without having to press play.
 Marks what is playing right now, so on a page full of media you pick the right one.
 Quality picker with the estimated size of each option, so you know what you are getting before you start.
 Convert to MP3: save just the audio of any video, YouTube included — perfect for music.
 Trim before downloading: pick a start and an end, and save only that part.
 If the connection drops in the middle of a direct file, the download picks up where it left off instead of starting over.
 Link scanner: sweep the page for downloadable files when nothing shows up.
 Handles encrypted and fragmented streams that simpler tools choke on.
 Finds images, PDFs, archives and other files too — switch each type on or off so the list shows only what you want.
 Thumbnails, so you can tell two videos apart.
 Downloads tab: everything you saved stays listed, ready to open again.
 Downloads keep going in the background: closing the popup does not stop them.
 Opens as a popup or in the Firefox sidebar.
ON ANDROID
It works in Firefox for Android like any other add-on. On the page with the video, open YDownloadNow from the Firefox menu, pick the quality, and tap to save the file when it is ready. It is the easy way to get YouTube music on your phone: open the song in Firefox, choose MP3 and the file is saved to your phone.
VERY LARGE FILES
Firefox builds the file in memory before saving it, so a very large file (roughly over 1 GB) can fail. YDownloadNow always tries; if a large download does fail, it offers you a lower quality with one click.
WHAT IT DOES NOT DO
It does not touch DRM-protected content. Widevine, PlayReady and SAMPLE-AES streams are refused by design, so it will not download from Netflix, Disney+, HBO or similar services — and it never will. Please only download content you have the right to, and respect each site's terms of service.
FREE AND PREMIUM
Free, every day (the counters reset daily):
- Any file by size: 15 up to 20 MB, 5 up to 200 MB and 1 larger (up to 2 GB each)
- 3 downloads from YouTube, TikTok, X and other social networks (up to 720p)
- 3 Suno songs
- Video quality up to 1080p
- A download that fails does not count.
Premium removes every daily limit and adds 1440p, 4K and 8K quality, files over 2 GB, faster downloads, resuming downloads that fail, 320 kbps MP3 with speed and pitch control, downloading everything on a page in one click, cloud download through our server, a file-name template, and a download history synced across your devices.
EUR 2.99 a month or EUR 19.99 a year, on up to 3 browsers, cancellable from the website whenever you want. Only need it for a while? Unlock it for 24 hours for EUR 0.99 or for a week for EUR 1.99, with no subscription.
PRIVACY
Detection, downloading and assembly happen in your browser, and the file is saved straight to your device. It does not pass through our server unless you choose a server-assisted download.
This is what the extension sends, and when:
Always, because the free plan cannot work without it:
- A random install ID, to count the daily limit and validate Premium, together with the browser and system it runs on. There is no account and we do not store your IP address.
Only if you allow it in Firefox's data-collection prompt:
- Your country.
- When a download fails: at which step it broke and an error code — never the raw error message.
- The domain of the page where a download finished (for example example.com ), stored without the install ID. It can also be turned off in Settings.
Only when you use the feature:
- YouTube and social networks: the page address is sent to our conversion service, because that is how those downloads work.
- Server-assisted download and Premium history sync, both off by default.
- A problem report from Settings: you see exactly what is sent before sending it; web addresses are cut down to the domain and file paths are removed.
Full privacy policy: https://ydownloadnow.com/en/privacy.html 
WHY IT NEEDS ITS PERMISSIONS
 Access to the sites you visit: a stream can only be found by watching the requests made by the page you are on. The page's content is never sent anywhere.
 Downloads: to save the finished file.
 Opening the downloaded file is optional — it is only requested when you press "Open file", and you can say no.
Support: support@ydownloadnow.com · https://ydownloadnow.com

firefox-addons:3076458.description:
Lock any tab, a whole site, or every open tab, behind one password.
Features:
- Lock this page, this site, or every tab, from the popup or the right-click menu
- Auto-lock list covering Facebook, Instagram, X/Twitter, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and more, plus your own domains. Subdomains and all paths are included
- Media hosts: a blocked site's video and image CDN is blocked too, and stays blocked even when you unlock the main site
- Quiet hours: during a window you choose, the password will not open blocked sites
- Unlock scope: keep a scrolling feed open, or open only that one page
- Inactivity re-lock, configurable, and media-aware: video that is already playing is never cut off
- One password for tabs and settings, with a recovery key shown once
- Local history of how long a blocked site stayed open, stored on this device only
- Export and import your settings as JSON
100% local: your password is stored only as a PBKDF2-SHA-256 hash. No accounts, no servers, no analytics. Nothing is ever transmitted.
Limitations (by Firefox design): system pages such as about:addons cannot be locked, and disabling or removing the extension is not preventable.

firefox-addons:2917276.name: SleepyTabs - Tab Suspender & Manager
firefox-addons:2917276.summary: SleepyTabs is a browser extension that helps you manage browser tabs by automatically putting inactive tabs to sleep to save memory and improve browser performance.
firefox-addons:2917276.description:
SleepyTabs - Browser Tab Suspender & Manager
SleepyTabs is a browser extension that helps you manage browser tabs by automatically putting inactive tabs to sleep to save memory and improve browser performance. SleepyTabs uses the browser api tabs.discard. Same as the native "Unload" uses, but with more features. If you want you can hide the native unload in browser settings. 
✨ Key Features
 🔄 Automatic Tab Sleeping - Save memory after your chosen inactivity period
 🎛️ Intuitive Controls - Sleep or wake tabs with simple clicks or keyboard shortcuts
 🎨 Beautiful Sleeping Pages - Customize with 10+ themes and wallpapers
 Caffeine List - Prevent specific sites from being put to sleep
 ⚙️ Granular Configuration - Fine-tune which tabs can sleep and when
 🔒 Privacy Focused - Works entirely in your browser, no data sent externally
 🌐 Sync Settings - Synchronize settings across multiple browsers
 📦 Import/Export - Easily backup or transfer your settings
🛠️ Tab Management
Basic Controls
 Sleep Current Tab - Immediately put the current tab to sleep
 Sleep All Tabs - Put all eligible tabs to sleep at once
 Wake All Tabs - Restore all sleeping tabs with one click
Tab Type Handling
 Pinned Tabs - Control sleep behavior for pinned tabs
 Grouped Tabs - Manage sleep settings for tab groups
 Private Tabs - Special handling for private/incognito windows
 Reader Mode Tabs - Custom behavior for reader view tabs
Tab State Management
 Active Tabs - Option to sleep even the currently active tab
 Audible Tabs - Control whether playing audio prevents sleeping
 Loading Tabs - Prevent sleeping of tabs that are still loading
 Attention-Requesting Tabs - Handle tabs that want your attention
🎭 Appearance Customization
Themes
Choose from multiple themes:
- Dark (Default) - Easy on the eyes in low light
- Light - Clean and bright interface
- Midnight - Deep blue dark theme
- Sepia - Warm, paper-like appearance
- Solarized - Precision colors for multiple applications
- Nord - Arctic, north-bluish color palette
- Forest - Nature-inspired green theme
- Monokai - Popular code editor theme
- Ayu Dark - Clean, modern dark theme
- Amethyst - Purple-inspired theme
You can also create your own themes in the theme creator!
Wallpapers
 Enable custom wallpapers for sleeping tabs
 Set any image URL as wallpaper
 Adjust brightness to your preference
Title Customization
 Add emoji prefixes to sleeping tabs
 Choose from preset emojis or set a custom prefix
 Options include: 💤 (Sleeping), 😴 (Sleep Face), 🛌 (In Bed), 🌙 (Moon), and more
⚙️ Advanced Settings
Performance
 Check Interval - How often to check for inactive tabs (default: 10s)
 Grace Period - Time since tab was last active before it is put to sleep
 Batch Processing - Control how many tabs are processed at once
 Sleep Delay - Time between processing individual tabs
Behavior
 Discard Only - Just unload tabs without showing sleep page
 Auto-Restore - Automatically wake tabs when clicked
 Floating UI - Keep the popup interface always visible
📂 Data Management
 Settings Sync - Keep your preferences in sync across browsers
 Import/Export - Backup or transfer your configuration
 Reset Options - Restore default settings when needed
⌨️ Keyboard Shortcuts
 Sleep Current Tab : Ctrl+Shift+1 
 Sleep All Tabs : Ctrl+Shift+2 
 Wake All Tabs : Ctrl+Shift+3 
 Open SleepyTabs Sidebar : Ctrl+Shift+4 
 Wake Sleeping Tab : Enter (when focused on a sleeping tab)
Technical Details
SleepyTabs is made for Firefox with support for Chrome. The extension works by:
 Monitoring tab activity using browser events
 Storing tab information in the browser's local storage
 Replacing inactive tabs with lightweight placeholder pages
 Restoring tabs to their original state when needed
Privacy
SleepyTabs operates entirely within your browser. No data is sent to external servers, and all tab information is stored locally in your browser's storage.

Contributions are welcome! Feel free to submit issues or merge requests to help improve SleepyTabs.

apple-macos:6782913967.name: FoxPhone - Cloud Phone Manager
apple-macos:6782913967.description:
FoxPhone is a cloud phone management app that lets you connect to and manage high-performance cloud mobile devices from your iPhone. Access your cloud phones, enter an independent cloud environment, and handle remote operation, device management, and daily maintenance with a smoother and more flexible experience.
【High-Performance Cloud Phone】
Run your cloud device with stable cloud computing resources while reducing pressure on your local storage, battery, and device performance. Enjoy a smooth cloud mobile experience without taking up large amounts of space on your iPhone.
【Privacy & Security】
Each cloud phone runs in an independent cloud environment, helping reduce local data exposure risks. Account information, device access, and cloud operations are separated to provide a more secure experience.
【Remote Access Anytime】
Open the app to view your cloud phone status, connect to your cloud device, and manage it remotely anytime, anywhere.
【Group Control & Efficient Management】
Search cloud phones by name or ID, organize devices into groups, and use group control, focus mode, and batch operations to manage multiple cloud phones more efficiently.
【Multiple Cloud Use Cases】
Suitable for app running, mobile office, remote assistance, account management, cloud testing, and other cloud-based scenarios. Available configurations, features, and service duration are subject to what is shown inside the app.
【24/7 Technical Support】
Our technical support team is available around the clock to help with cloud phone connection, usage experience, and account-related issues. If you encounter any problem, you can contact us through in-app support, and we will assist you as soon as possible.
